inputs.description: Nothing is required: free OpenGFX graphics, OpenSFX sounds and OpenMSX music are built in. If you own Transport Tycoon Deluxe you can add its data in the app later; the build never reads it.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneOS SDK
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

publication.reason: OpenTTDPad is GPLv2 and bundles only freely redistributable content (OpenGFX, OpenSFX, OpenMSX, TimGM6mb). Releases publish an unsigned IPA with its corresponding source; no original Transport Tycoon Deluxe data is included.
